deep_dive.title: BlindPSNR: A No-Reference Fidelity Predictor for Low-Light Image Enhancement
deep_dive.abstract: Low-light image enhancement (LLIE) methods involve tunable parameters that are typically fixed, often leading to performance degradation when applied across scenes. Manually selecting the best configuration, however, can be time-consuming and not always practical. Peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) is the natural fidelity criterion for automating parameter selection, yet it requires a ground-truth reference that is typically unavailable. To our knowledge, no learning-based method addresses no-reference PSNR prediction for low-light image enhancement; the natural surrogate, no-reference image quality assessment (NR-IQA), targets perceptual quality rather than signal fidelity, and all seven baselines we test achieve 0% top-1 selection accuracy on our benchmark. With paired training data, the ground-truth PSNR is analytically computable, providing exact supervision without a separate teacher network. Building on this, we propose BlindPSNR, a lightweight no-reference network that fuses the enhanced image with the degraded low-light input via windowed cross-attention and estimates PSNR through heteroscedastic regression. While a scalar-regression baseline achieves top-1 accuracy of 54.4%, BlindPSNR raises this to 89.5% with regret dropping from 1.62 dB to 0.026 dB, and generalizes to unseen datasets (SRCC = 0.61-0.67).

deep_dive.llm_tldr_en: BlindPSNR is a learning-based method that predicts PSNR without a ground-truth reference, enabling automatic parameter selection for low-light image enhancement methods. It addresses the limitation that existing NR-IQA methods focus on perceptual quality rather than signal fidelity.
deep_dive.llm_tldr_cn: 针对低光图像增强方法参数选择需要参考图像的问题，本文提出了BlindPSNR，一种无参考的PSNR预测器。现有无参考图像质量评价方法关注感知质量而非信号保真度，作者专门设计了面向低光增强的保真度预测模型。实验表明，该方法能够准确预测PSNR，从而实现自动参数选择，解决了手动调参的低效与不可行问题。
